' "$J" | tail -300; echo ===TURN_MARKERS===; printf '%s
' "$J" | grep -Eai 'gespraech\.aktiv=1|user_speech|transcript|OMEGA|world|GRID|GRF|externalized|regulation|response_released|turn_event|frame_id|RealtimeSession|websocket|connected' || echo NO_GENUINE_TURN_MARKERS; echo ===IDLE_MARKERS===; printf '%s
' "$J" | grep -E 'gespraech\.aktiv=0|pausiert|Stopped|Started' | tail -80 || true; echo FRED_PR133_REAL_VOICE_TURN_READONLY_DONE
